drifted.spec_text: Feature-gated telemetry tracks min/max/mean latency; the Last-Synced note asserts the hardcoded-0 latency defect was fixed in code (per-op start captured, elapsed ns recorded).
drifted.actual: Fix present in sync paths and wait_for_cqe, but the primary async-completion path harvest_completions() still calls record_op(0, op.bytes) with hardcoded 0 latency, despite InflightOp carrying a populated start timestamp. Async ReadAsync/WriteAsync ops record 0ns latency, driving min_latency_ns to 0 and skewing mean.

drifted.spec_text: Feature-gated telemetry produces accurate TelemetrySnapshot values when enabled.
drifted.actual: Latency values inaccurate for async operations because harvest_completions records 0ns latency; snapshot min/mean latency wrong when async IO dominates. Same root cause as FR-021.

unspecced.feature: Command::FlushSync handler returning FlushDone{Ok} as a validated no-op (O_DIRECT|O_DSYNC leaves no volatile write cache); ns_id!=1 -> InvalidNamespace. Kernel spec never mentions FlushSync.
unspecced.suggested_spec: Backfill an FR (parallel to filesys FR-022) documenting FlushSync as a validated no-op justified by O_DSYNC durability.
